DEFENDANT HARTOG BAER HAND IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY KEVIN O'BRIEN, COUNSEL. DEFENDANTS WAIVE ANY SERVICE ISSUES. AFTER INQUIRY, HONORABLE MICHELLE ALLOWS THE DEFENDANT HARTOG BAER HAND REPRESENTED BY KEVIN O'BRIEN, ESQ TO BE HEARD. DEFENDANT (LEFT) EXHIBITS RETAINED. SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-23-2022 - JUDGMENT.
